explanation: Jørn Utzon won the design competition in 1957 but resigned in 1966, years before it opened. He never returned to Australia to see it finished.

claims.text: The Sydney Opera House was designed by Jørn Utzon, a Danish architect.
Jørn Utzon was not Australian, Swedish or Finnish.
Utzon won the Sydney Opera House design competition in 1957.
Utzon resigned from the project in 1966, years before the building opened in 1973.
Utzon never returned to Australia to see the finished Sydney Opera House.
